namespace = dod_amz

# Generated by tools/port_missing.py from the Vic2 DoD files the content audit found missing.

dod_amz.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = dod_amz.1.t
	desc = dod_amz.1.d
	flavor = dod_amz.1.f
	event_image = { video = "rp1_amazon_exploitation" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = { c:SPA ?= this c:CLM ?= this }
		exists = c:AMA
		c:AMA = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_PARA }
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_amz_para_dropped }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = dod_amz_para_settled }
		is_at_war = no
	}

	option = {
		name = dod_amz.1.a
		default_option = yes
		save_scope_as = dod_amz_claimant
		c:AMA = { trigger_event = { id = dod_amz.2 days = 14 } }
		ai_chance = { base = 50 }
	}

	option = {
		name = dod_amz.1.b
		save_scope_as = dod_amz_claimant
		c:AMA = { trigger_event = { id = dod_amz.3 days = 14 } }
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = dod_amz.1.c
		set_variable = dod_amz_para_dropped
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}
}

	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = dod_amz.5.t
	desc = dod_amz.5.d
	flavor = dod_amz.5.f
	event_image = { video = "ip2_unruly_soldiers" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		c:AMA ?= this
		game_date >= 1842.1.1
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_amz_chaos_done }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = dod_amz_chaos_done
	}

	option = {
		name = dod_amz.5.a
		default_option = yes

		add_modifier = { name = dod_amz_military_rule months = 120 }

	}
}

	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = dod_amz.7.t
	desc = dod_amz.7.d
	flavor = dod_amz.7.f

	trigger = {
		c:AMA ?= this
		has_variable = dod_amz_military_rule
		NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_monarchy }
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_amz_king_done }
